name: Instagram Comment Automation - Private Reply + Public Reply

parameters.content:
## Instagram Comment Automation

Graph API version: **v26.0** (verify against https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/changelog and bump the version in the HTTP Request node URLs if a newer version is required).

Env vars required (see README.md):
- INSTAGRAM_ACCESS_TOKEN
- INSTAGRAM_USER_ID
- INSTAGRAM_VERIFY_TOKEN

Credentials required: one **Postgres** credential (configure it on every Postgres node after import).

Follow gate: set `followGate: true` on a rule. The first DM has a button; on tap the workflow checks if the person follows you (User Profile API) and sends the link, or asks them to follow first with "M'abonner" + "C'est fait" buttons.
Requires the webhook field **messaging_postbacks** (+ comments) and the permission instagram_business_manage_messages.

DM with button: set `buttonTitle` + `buttonUrl` on a rule in "Message Rules Configuration" to send a Button Template (text + clickable button). Leave `buttonUrl` empty to send plain text.

This workflow does NOT verify the X-Hub-Signature-256 header. See README "Hardening" section.

## Retry design

Send Private Reply / Reply to Comment use onError = "continue using error output" (success = output 0, error = output 1).
HTTP Request outputs (success and error) do NOT carry the input fields, so the nodes right after them
recover the context with $('Select Random DM').item / $('Select Random Public Reply').item (paired items).
The attempt counter uses $runIndex of the Classify node (1st run = attempt 1).

The Classify-Error nodes read the status code defensively (error.httpCode / error.statusCode / error.cause.httpCode).
**Verify this against your instance during testing.**

429 / 500 / 502 / 503 / 504 -> retry (max 3 attempts, Retry-After honoured, else exponential backoff)
400 / 401 / 403 -> permanent, no retry

If the DM succeeds but the public reply fails, the row stays dm_status=sent / public_reply_status=failed.
Use "Retry Failed Public Replies" to retry ONLY the public reply, never the DM.

nodes.name: Instagram Webhook Verify (GET)
nodes.notes: Meta calls this once when you save the webhook subscription in the App Dashboard.

nodes.name: Instagram Webhook Events (POST)
nodes.notes: Responds 200 immediately (Meta requires a fast ack) then keeps processing below.

nodes.name: Extract Comment Events
nodes.notes: Emits one item per comment (event_type=comment) and one per DM button tap (event_type=postback). Everything else is ignored.

nodes.name: Ignore - Invalid Event
nodes.notes: Status: comment ignored (malformed payload - missing comment_id or media_id).

nodes.name: Ignore Own Comments
nodes.notes: Also prevents infinite loops: our own public replies re-appear as new comments, but from_id will match our account.

nodes.name: Ignore - Own Comment
nodes.notes: Status: comment ignored (posted by our own Instagram account).

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO ig_processed_comments (comment_id, media_id, comment_text, username, created_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, now())
ON CONFLICT (comment_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING comment_id, media_id, comment_text, username;

nodes.name: Reserve Comment (Atomic)
nodes.notes: Atomic dedup+reservation in a single statement. If the comment_id already exists, 0 rows are returned and nothing flows downstream. RETURNING echoes back every column downstream nodes need.

nodes.name: Message Rules Configuration
nodes.notes: EDIT ME: keywords, DM texts, follow-gate texts, button titles and links. Shared by the comment flow and the DM button flow.

nodes.name: Send Private Reply
nodes.notes: POST /{ig-user-id}/messages - private reply to the comment. Body is built in Select Random DM (postback button if followGate, URL button otherwise). One private reply per comment_id max. Output 0 = success, output 1 = error.

parameters.query:
UPDATE ig_processed_comments
SET matched_rule = $2, selected_dm = $3, dm_status = 'sent'
WHERE comment_id = $1
RETURNING comment_id, username, matched_rule, selected_dm, dm_status;

nodes.name: Update Row - DM Sent
nodes.notes: RETURNING passes comment_id downstream to the public reply branch.

nodes.name: Update Row - DM Failed
nodes.notes: Status: DM echoue - reponse publique volontairement non envoyee.

nodes.name: Public Replies Configuration
nodes.notes: EDIT ME: the list of possible public replies lives only here.

parameters.jsCode: const list = $json.publicReplies; return { json: { ...$json, selected_public_reply: list[Math.floor(Math.random() * list.length)] } };

nodes.name: Reply to Comment
nodes.notes: POST /{ig-comment-id}/replies. Only runs once the private reply has succeeded. Output 0 = success, output 1 = error.

parameters.jsCode:
const base = $('Select Random Public Reply').item.json;
return { json: { ...base, public_reply_status: 'sent' } };

nodes.name: Save Success
nodes.notes: Status: DM envoye, reponse publique envoyee.

nodes.name: Update Row - Public Reply Failed
nodes.notes: Status: DM envoye, reponse publique echouee. Utiliser le workflow "Retry Failed Public Replies" pour reessayer uniquement cette etape.

nodes.name: Handle Error
nodes.notes: Single terminal node for all error branches - makes failed executions easy to spot in the n8n Executions list.

nodes.name: Keyword Matched?
nodes.notes: Continue only if the comment contains a keyword from Message Rules Configuration. Otherwise: no DM, no public reply.

nodes.name: Ignore - No Keyword
nodes.notes: Status: comment ignored (no keyword from the rules list).

nodes.name: Is Comment?
nodes.notes: true = new comment -> existing comment flow. false = DM button tap (postback) -> follow-gate flow.

nodes.name: Get Follow Status
nodes.notes: User Profile API. Needs instagram_business_manage_messages + user consent (the person messaged / tapped a button). Output 0 = success, output 1 = error.

nodes.name: Follow Status Unknown
nodes.notes: Fallback: if Meta refuses the follow check, send the link anyway rather than blocking the user.

nodes.name: Send Postback Reply
nodes.notes: Reply in the conversation (the button tap opened a 24h messaging window). Output 0 = success, output 1 = error.

nodes.name: Postback Reply Sent
nodes.notes: Status: follow-gate reply sent (see outcome: link_sent / asked_to_follow / still_not_following).
